name: Lyrical ~Dramatic Stories~
source:
Lyrical DS contains eight after stories of the Lyrical Lyric heroines. Also, heroines from Miraroma and Konneko appear. You can enjoy dramatic love stories with them.

[From Himeya Shop]
translation:
《Lyrical DS》收录了《Lyrical Lyric》各位女主角的八篇后日谈。《Miraroma》和《Konneko》的女主角也会登场。你可以与她们一同体验扣人心弦的爱情故事。

[摘自Himeya Shop]
